# Weekly update — `[CLIENT]` / week `[N]`

> Send every week without fail, alongside a **working demo they can click**.
> A status email is not a demo. The demo is what stops "this isn't what I
> pictured" — the gap can only ever be one week wide.
>
> Keep it short. Five minutes to write, one minute to read.

---

### Notes on writing these

- **Report a slip the week it happens**, not the week before the deadline. A
  problem raised early is a project being managed; the same problem raised late
  is a project being covered up.
- **Log client-side delays here in writing.** Dependencies that slip are the
  most common cause of a late project, and the record protects both sides.
- If a week produced little, say that plainly and explain why. Clients handle
  honest slow weeks far better than vague ones.
